headline: Gambling package suddenly emerges, then stalls in Alabama Senate
snippet: Conference compromise won House approval but fell one vote short of three-fifths supermajority in Senate (20-15).

headline: Alabama Senate passes stripped-down gambling legislation
snippet: Senate passed narrower version removing casino gaming and sports betting, keeping lottery and electronic games.

headline: Alabama House approves legislation establishing lottery, casino gambling, sports wagering
snippet: House approved HB151 by 72-29, first time chamber passed comprehensive gambling legislation.

headline: Comparing House and Senate versions of the 2024 Alabama legal gaming bills
snippet: Side-by-side comparison of House/Senate disagreements on scope of gaming, casino locations, sports wagering.
